Checked both directions. Finitely many downward support cones give finite strict upper sets, so descending weight induction terminates. U(n-minus)-linearity and weight-vector generator images suffice: the quotient projection is h-equivariant, even though phi need not be. The zero target makes both maps surjective; a zero map to a nonzero category-O target cannot be surjective on coinvariants by the same induction. Reader correction removes an unassumed h-linearity claim. PBW, support, triangular and category-O interfaces read. Pre/post snapshot comparison: carrier changed; reader repair retained.

Reviewed every lifting case: a rising lower vertex cannot use the last descending simple letter; simultaneous rises are order-preserving; simultaneous descents reduce the upper length. That case has exactly one rising middle, while y not<=xs forces both to rise. Induction starts at upper length two and terminates. Checked the full principal-ideal induction and both diamond cases. Outside I(ws), every vertex descends and its s-translate belongs to I(ws); a nonvertical edge has descending target and a side diamond. With neither middle vertical, multiply four side diamonds and the translated diamond; with a vertical middle, either it is the side diamond or three diamonds cancel all extra edges. Longest ideal covers W. For two signings the ratio product is one; setting c(x)=r(x,xs)c(xs) and using each side diamond gives every edge ratio c(x)/c(y), c(e)=1. Reader adds this complete finite proof. Rank zero is vacuous and no infinite Choice is used. Pre/post snapshot comparison: carrier changed; reader repair retained.

Reviewed each degree-one component as a signed nonzero inclusion with proper image. The sum of singular-vector submodules is proper, and its preimage is K+sum U(g) f_i^(m_i+1), giving the dominant integrable cyclic quotient. Finite dimensionality and complete reducibility force this cyclic top-weight-one quotient to be the single L(lambda) summand. Unique maximality gives image d1=ker pi. For rank zero the empty sum is zero and M(0)=L(0)=C. Contract correction correctly uses the g-submodule generated by each singular vector, not the image of left multiplication f_i^(m_i+1) on all M(lambda). Exact integrability, classification, reducibility and singular-vector interfaces read; no residual defect. Pre/post snapshot comparison: item bytes unchanged; contract audit enrichment reviewed.
